title: Group the anagrams
description:
Group words that are anagrams of each other with a hash map.

```
aelpst: pastel plates staple
eilnst: enlist listen silent
opst:   post pots spot stop tops
```
hints: Copy the keys into a vector and sort it, because an `unordered_map` has no order.
requirements: The key of a word is its letters sorted.
Print the groups with more than one word, sorted by key, with the words sorted.
stretch: Use a count of each letter as the key instead of sorting, and compare the speed for long words.
